messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — opened a tiny docs PR to unify streaming + pagination examples across py/ts/go. Found an edge where resume tokens are dropped on intermittent errors, so I added a small helper and adjusted the samples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

sam: taking a look. do you have a repro?

maria: repro: call stream with page tokens + intermittent 500, client retries but iterator restarts from page 1. Fix is to stash the last good page token and pass it to resume_stream helper after transient failures. Example:

maria: ```python
# python snippet (sync and async variants in repo)
from redwood import RedwoodClient
from redwood.utils import resume_stream_with_page_token

client = RedwoodClient()
page_token = None
for chunk in resume_stream_with_page_token(client.stream_pages, page_token):
    process(chunk)
```

maria: ```ts
// typescript snippet (async iterator)
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference'
import { resumeStreamWithPageToken } from '@redwood/docs-utils'

const client = new Redwood()
let pageToken: string | null = null
for await (const page of resumeStreamWithPageToken(() => client.streamPages({ pageToken }))) {
  handlePage(page)
  pageToken = page.nextToken ?? null
}
```

sam: nice. for TS/py we should show exponential backoff jitter too. i pasted a compact helper with retries in the PR suggestion. also watch that the TS example awaits the call factory, not the iterator itself.

anya: flagged a broken link in the PR — the old docs link /docs/streaming-examples is 404. we should point folks at /docs/reference/streaming and also update the anchor for pagination. small patch in my review.

docs-bot: Lint report: docs/snippets/streaming-pagination.md: line 42: MD034/no-bare-urls. Suggest wrapping PR URL in reference format.

ci-bot: running tests on PR 482...

ci-bot: integration:examples:python: failed — flake8: trailing whitespace in docs/snippets/python/streaming.md:45

maria: fixed whitespace and wrapped the PR link, pushed force. thanks anya for the link catch.

hugo: @maria glanced quickly — snippet changes look fine. can you add one sentence calling out that resume helper preserves the last seen page token across retries? then i'm good to approve. :thumbsup:

maria: done. added a short note and a tiny diagram (ASCII) showing token flow. pinging for review again.

hugo: approved. merging after CI green. :rocket:

ci-bot: all checks passed on merge. release note: docs: unify streaming/pagination examples + resume helper (PR #482)

maria: thanks team — will follow up with a short migration note for customers who implemented custom resumers.
